title: a or az? — furniture and the definite article

sections.content: The definite article is a before a consonant and az before a vowel. asztal and ágy both start with a vowel, so they take az: az asztal, az ágy. szék and kanapé start with a consonant, so they take a: a szék, a kanapé.
This a/az rule isn't unique to furniture — it applies to every noun in Hungarian. Furniture words just happen to give you a clean set to drill it on, since two start with vowels and two don't.
